introduction: Follow the six clan swords to Kunji, with hidden-source guidance, competing foreign uses and city services explained by their actual behavior.
orientation: Enter Mitashi through its northern gate, then explore the markets, barracks, Harmony Garden, clan compounds, docks and southern homes. The bay needs eligible water travel. Current visibility, occupancy, combat and stock still matter.

Find Kunji Pishida in the abandoned warehouse basement. The warehouse is connected to the city, with ordinary DOWN and UP access to the spirit. The dark rooms can affect sight; no magical password, garden item or clan affiliation is a declared entry requirement.

Ask Kunji sword or swords, torment, and empress. These four words select three native responses. They explain the seven swords and his anger at the Empress; each attempted word is not a separate achievement.

Collect one each of the six named clan katanas. Ordinary clan swords, knives, similar names or six copies of one katana do not replace the six different required kinds. Each optional row checks current directly carried prototypes and can become missing again after you spend the item. Ready now does not independently check sight or durable ownership; actual offering admission can still refuse.

The Raven, Leopard, Snow Dragon and Tiger leaders have their katanas equipped when stocked. The Crane and Rat leaders carry hidden katanas. If a hidden sword reaches a corpse or open container, successful SEARCH may reveal it before recovery; that action depends on visibility and chance. A source declaration does not guarantee a present recoverable sword.

Carry the exact six swords together, loose rather than worn, held or inside containers, then offer a named visible sword to Kunji. Supplied exact swords also fit; the native return does not require your own clan-leader kills, source recovery or earlier conversation. Under active accounting, incomplete sets stay with you.

Kunji consumes the complete six-sword set, gives Retribution and departs. The accepted receipt remains recorded after the swords are spent. His revenge tale does not implement a later Empress kill or release-the-spirit objective in this recipe.

Choose how to spend the swords: Lynstar in the Savannah accepts each clan katana for a different legendary instrument, then accepts Retribution plus a matching instrument for its epic upgrade. The Plane of Air also needs The North Wind in a separate nine-item Cloudseeker return. These exchanges consume competing physical items and keep separate recipient histories.

Retribution can be equipment or a later offering. Its generic combat effect includes two cure-critical entries and spirit anguish, subject to actual trigger, target and item-action settings. Possession, healing prose and an attempted strike do not prove a successful effect or another quest completion.

Hengi, Xial and the market food and knife merchants offer town context. Their native shop mutations currently refuse while accounting is active. Le Ming describes a closed poison service, and Can Hy has stable lore without a selected horse purchase service. Do not plan a required purchase from those descriptions.

Seven Gardens has an actual inn handler. RENT depends on character eligibility and successful terminal saving; visiting the room or receiving a handled refusal is separate from successful renting. Gardens, noble followers and dock scenery do not create collection, escort or ship-purchase receipts.

New discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily progress requires active, ready accounting. The one native return remains one achievement and one potential daily. Daily rollover does not restock six cap-one swords or restore a departed Kunji.

stories.title: Return the six clan swords to Kunji
